mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% is associated with negative 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals economic weakness that triggers a flight to quality in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) combined with a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months and FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months and FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle supply shock regime (defined by INDPRO < 105.0), a decline in industrial production increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the regime where INDPRO < 105.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1150.0 is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) below 440000 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 signals a deepening housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 440000 and HOUST < 1150.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals economic distress that increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 235.0 signals an overheating economy that triggers a monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 235.0 is associated with positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
